svg.title: qwen-warp: can autonomous AI research beat vLLM on one RTX 3090?
svg.desc: Infographic: an experiment in autonomous research. A human directed AI agents that built a Qwen serving stack faster than vLLM on one RTX 3090. Shows the research loop, the autonomous optimisation campaign, a timeline, performance progression, predictions versus reality, failures, a comparison with HyperQwen and real code snippets.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: AN EXPERIMENT IN AUTONOMOUS RESEARCH · ONE RTX 3090 · ~2 DAYS

svg.text: gate = paired pristine controls + hidden held-out + plain guard + teacher-forced check, 12.6 GPU-min; held-out and plain guard never dropped below 0.995

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Why zero rejections? The agents' quick tries filtered ideas first (their lab notebooks keep the rejected ones: a register-rotation variant -2%, a side-stream split measured slower,
